; BIND reverse data file for empty rfc1918 zone
;
; DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE - it is used for multiple zones.
; Instead, copy it, edit named.conf, and use that copy.
;
;$TTL	86400
$TTL	7200
@	IN	SOA	ns1.example.com. root.example.com. (
			 2026072301		; Serial
			 604800		; Refresh
			  86400		; Retry
			2419200		; Expire
			  86400 )	; Negative Cache TTL
;
;@	IN	NS	localhost.

; Name servers for this domain
	IN	NS	ns1.example.com.
	IN	NS	ns2.example.com.

; Mail servers for this domain. A small number (10) indicates this sever has higher priority
	IN	MX  10	mail.example.com.


; A records
ns1	IN	A	100.76.180.127
ns2	IN	A	100.76.180.127
@	IN	A	100.76.180.127
mail	IN	A	100.76.180.127
www	IN	A	100.76.180.127
example.com.	IN	A	100.76.180.127



; CNAME records
test	IN	CNAME	example.com.

@               IN      TXT     "v=spf1 mx ip4:100.76.180.127 ~all"

;_dmarc          600     IN      TXT             "v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:postmaster@example.com"
;v=DMARC1; p=none; sp=quarantine;
_dmarc          600     IN      TXT             "v=DMARC1; p=none; sp=quarantine;pct=100; fo=0;rua=mailto:postmaster@example.com; ruf=mailto:dmarc@example.com;"

myselector._domainkey   IN      TXT     ( "v=DKIM1; k=rsa; s=email; "

          "5KVE5Gs6B3fLQ/EQQg3CmIBg6hY72v8+koSTpgbYQuyzSAPKFlz5zLfXDwCNNrX8qqeB1FkoQC5r9Uf3STGYYStnNZPsvXMvCV8tESH/WARLBELvz77/Hnmo7Uz0C475oBz5QbPwIDAQAB" )  ; ----- DKIM key myselector for example.com
